projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.franken: A Transylian: a huge Frankenstein-like brute whose shoulder bolts are electrodes. He soaks up electricity -- lightning, power sources, the air in a storm -- and banks it as Charge, then throws it back as shock punches, lightning bolts, ground slams and a whole storm of strikes. Lightning never hurts him, it recharges him, and he can call a bolt down onto himself. He is very strong but heavy, and water bleeds his Charge away. He is not on the dial at first: an 11th mistransform (or 22nd, 33rd...) may find him, and from then on you can dial him.
message.projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstri: Not enough Charge (needs %s). Recharge (hold V) or call lightning (Shift+V).
Low Charge: only a weak bolt (a full one needs %s).
You need ground under you to slam.
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.shock: A charged haymaker into the creature ahead (4 blocks): 8, and the current jumps to the nearest other creature within 6 blocks: 6. +6 Charge when it lands.
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.light: A bolt from your hand at the crosshair (28 blocks): 15, using 15 Charge. With less Charge it is a weak static bolt (7).
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.condu: Both fists into the ground, using 20 Charge: 17 to everything within 5.5 blocks, thrown up. With less Charge: 9 within 3.5 blocks.
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.elect: A huge leap where you look, with no fall damage. Landing with 10+ Charge spends 10 on a shock round you: 10 within 3.5 blocks.
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.overc: Ultimate (50 Charge): for 3 s the sky answers you -- eight lightning strikes on the creatures round you (14 blocks): 24 each, stunned 1 s. The lightning starts no fires and breaks nothing.
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.grab_: Grab the creature ahead (4 blocks) and hold it up for 2 s, shocking it for 4 every half second, then throw it: 4 more (20 in all). Press again to throw it early. A boss is too big to lift: it is pinned instead.
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.quick: Tap V: draw the static out of the air, +8 Charge.
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.recha: Hold V to channel electricity into your bolts for as long as you like: +6 Charge a second, twice that near power (a lightning rod, powered redstone or a beacon within 6 blocks) and three times in a thunderstorm under open sky. You are slowed while you channel.
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.light: Call a bolt of lightning down onto your own electrodes: +50 Charge, +4 health, and 8 to everything within 3 blocks.
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.galva: Your punches hit hard (+9) and each one feeds your bolts (+4 Charge). With 50+ Charge every punch also shocks for 3.
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.trans: Lightning never hurts you: a strike gives you 50 Charge and 6 health.
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.brute: Big and tough: 40 health, heavy armour, and hard to knock back.
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.livin: Your shocks hit machines (golems, robots) for half again.
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.groun: In water your Charge leaks away, 2 a second.
projecthero.omnitrix.frankenstrike.lumbe: Heavy and slow: you walk slower and can't sprint-jump far.
Electric brute: banks Charge and spends it on shock punches, bolts, slams and a storm of lightning.
Transylian: lightning gives him 50 Charge and 6 health and never hurts him.
Recharges by holding V (faster near power or in a storm) and calls lightning on himself (Shift+V).
Brute Strength: 40 health, heavy armour, hard to knock back.
Living Dynamo: shocks hit machines (golems, robots) for half again.
Needs Charge: his big moves are weak or locked without it, and it empties when he turns back.
Grounded: in water his Charge leaks away, 2 a second.
Lumbering: slow, and no long sprint-jumps.
Not on the dial until a mistransform (the 11th, 22nd, 33rd...) finds him.
